desc: a hollow soldier: an animated skeleton in a rusted iron skullcap helm and a tattered dark cape with an orange crown sigil on the chest, a short iron sword held low in one hand, the OTHER hand EMPTY (it carries NO shield and no second weapon), bare bone legs and bone feet
defect: the same leg leading in both halves and only two real poses

desc: the unnamed echo walking AWAY from the viewer: a dark armored warrior with a blazing FLAMING SKULL for a head (orange fire licking upward from the skull), two large tattered dark-feathered WINGS spread from the back and filling most of the figure's width, dark plate armor, a dagger held low, seen from behind so the wings' backs face the camera
